name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.unipPow
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → Unip g → InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ R) := by
intro l _ X _ _ R g hgen hu
let p : Submodule ℤ_[l] X := LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X))
have memp : ∀ v : X, v ∈ p ↔ ∃ y, v = (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ 1 • y := by
simp only [p, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, pow_one]
exact ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, hy.symm⟩, fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, hy.symm⟩⟩
let F : Module.End ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) := p.mapQ p (g - 1) hp
have hFx : ∀ x : X, F (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk ((g - 1) x) :=
have key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : X), (F ^ k) (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (((g - 1) ^ k) x) := by
rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hFx, ih, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
have hlen : Module.length ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) ≤ R := cokL l X R hgen
have hF0 := nilLen ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) F R hnil hlen
rw [hF0, LinearMap.zero_apply, eq_comm, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, memp] at hk
show: If an ℓ-adic module X is generated by R elements and g is unipotent modulo ℓ, the R-th power of g−1 has image in ℓX.
strategy: Descend g−1 to X modulo ℓX. There it is nilpotent and the module has length at most R. The length bound for nilpotent maps gives the stated exponent.

steps.claim: Write $T=g-1$ and $P=\ell X$, the image of multiplication by $\ell$. By unipotence choose $N$ with $T^N X\subseteq P$. The aim is to replace this exponent by the generator bound $R$.
steps.snippet:
∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → Unip g → InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ R) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R g hgen hu
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hu
  let p : Submodule ℤ_[l] X := LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X))

steps.claim: An element $v$ belongs to $P$ precisely when $v=\ell y$ for some $y\in X$, by the definition of $P$ as the image of scalar multiplication.
steps.snippet:
have memp : ∀ v : X, v ∈ p ↔ ∃ y, v = (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ 1 • y := by
    intro v
    simp only [p, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, pow_one]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, hy.symm⟩, fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, hy.symm⟩⟩

steps.claim: The submodule $P$ is stable under $T$. If $v=\ell y$, linearity gives $T(v)=\ell T(y)\in P$.
steps.snippet:
have hp : p ≤ p.comap (g - 1) := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (memp v).mp hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, map_smul]
    exact (memp _).mpr ⟨(g - 1) y, rfl⟩

steps.claim: Stability of $P$ lets $T$ descend to a linear endomorphism $F$ of the quotient $X/P$.
steps.snippet: let F : Module.End ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) := p.mapQ p (g - 1) hp

steps.claim: For any $x\in X$, the induced map is given by $F([x])=[T x]$ by construction of the quotient action.
steps.snippet:
have hFx : ∀ x : X, F (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk ((g - 1) x) :=
    fun x => Submodule.mapQ_apply _ _ _ x
steps.typedFact: ∀ x : X, F (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk ((g - 1) x)

steps.claim: For every natural $k$ and every $x$, $F^k([x])=[T^k x]$ because the quotient map intertwines one application of $T$ with one of $F$.
steps.snippet:
have key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : X), (F ^ k) (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (((g - 1) ^ k) x) := by
    intro k
steps.typedFact: ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : X), (F ^ k) (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (((g - 1) ^ k) x)

children.claim: Induction on $k$ compares the two powers on all representatives. Each successor power first applies the endomorphism once, then its $k$-th power.
For $k=0$ both powers are identity maps, giving $F^0([x])=[x]=[T^0x]$.
Assuming $F^k([y])=[T^k y]$ for every $y$, use $y=Tx$ to obtain $F^{k+1}([x])=F^k([Tx])=[T^k(Tx)]=[T^{k+1}x]$.
children.snippet:
| succ k ih =>
      intro x
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hFx, ih, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]

steps.claim: The map $F$ is nilpotent with $F^N=0$. Every quotient class is $[x]$ and $F^N([x])=[T^N x]=0$ since $T^N x\in P$.
steps.snippet:
have hnil : IsNilpotent F := by
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective p z
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, key, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, memp]
    exact hN x

steps.claim: The length of $X/P=X/\ell X$ is at most $R$, since the $R$ given generators map to a generating set over the residue field.
steps.snippet: have hlen : Module.length ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) ≤ R := cokL l X R hgen

steps.claim: A nilpotent endomorphism on a module of length at most $R$ has $R$-th power zero. Thus $[T^R x]=F^R([x])=0$ for every $x$, which means $T^R X\subseteq P=\ell X$.
steps.snippet:
have hF0 := nilLen ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) F R hnil hlen
  intro x
  have hk := key R x
  rw [hF0, LinearMap.zero_apply, eq_comm, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, memp] at hk
  exact hk

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
